Class ViewSpec

java.lang.Object
network.ike.knowledge.spi.ViewSpec
public final class ViewSpec extends Object
The view specification — dotted dimension keys mirroring the coordinate constituents (stamp, language, logic, navigation, edit), stating only what differs from the implementation's defaults (IKE-Network/ike-issues#849; normative schema: IKE-KNOWLEDGE-VIEW, IKE-Network/ike-issues#851).

Values are strings: concept dimensions carry ConceptRef forms, list dimensions carry comma-separated entries in preference order, and STAMP_POSITION_TIME carries latest or an ISO-8601 instant. Keys are validated strictly against the published key set — an unknown key fails fast, so a typo never silently becomes a default.

Additional language coordinates (ordered fallbacks) use an index segment: language.2.language, language.2.dialects, … — the unindexed language.* keys are the primary language coordinate.

Resolution — turning dimension values into coordinate records against a store and its bindings — happens on the implementation side of the seam. This type is the portable, engine-ignorant carrier; implementations report the fully resolved effective view beside their outputs.
